Name: TextTwist 2
Description: A word game: make as many words as you can from a scrambled handful of letters, and find the longest one to advance.

Achievements.Name: High Five
Achievements.Description: Solve five words without twisting in Unlimited, Standard, Daily Word or Letter Mania.

Achievements.Name: On a Roll
Achievements.Description: Solve ten words without twisting in Unlimited, Standard, Daily Word or Letter Mania.

Achievements.Name: Knock Out
Achievements.Description: Solve twenty words without twisting in Unlimited, Standard, Daily Word or Letter Mania.

Achievements.Name: Brainstorm
Achievements.Description: Solve a Lightning round without twisting.

Achievements.Name: Lightning Bolt
Achievements.Description: Complete a Lightning round with no hints given.

Achievements.Name: Twisted
Achievements.Description: Twist a 1000 times.

Achievements.Name: Swift Speller
Achievements.Description: Complete a round in less than five seconds in Unlimited, Standard or Daily Word.

Achievements.Name: Rock Steady
Achievements.Description: Solve all words in one round with no twisting in Unlimited, Standard or Daily Word.

Achievements.Name: Bingo Blaster
Achievements.Description: Complete only Bingo words in five levels in a row in Unlimited or Standard.

Achievements.Name: Bingo Boss
Achievements.Description: Complete only Bingo words in ten levels in a row in Unlimited or Standard.

Achievements.Name: Bingo Bonkers
Achievements.Description: Complete only Bingo words in twenty levels in a row in Unlimited or Standard.

Achievements.Name: Word Nerd
Achievements.Description: Spell 1000 words.

Achievements.Name: Word Herder
Achievements.Description: Spell 5000 words.

Achievements.Name: Apprentice
Achievements.Description: Complete 5 rounds in all game modes.

Achievements.Name: Journeyman
Achievements.Description: Complete 10 rounds in all game modes.

Achievements.Name: Grand Master
Achievements.Description: Complete 30 rounds in all game modes.

Achievements.Name: Roundabout
Achievements.Description: Complete a round in all game modes.

Achievements.Name: Letter Loon
Achievements.Description: Solve ten words in Letter Mania.

Achievements.Name: Letter Maniac
Achievements.Description: Solve twenty words in Letter Mania.

Achievements.Name: Nutty Cake
Achievements.Description: Complete an entire round of Letter Mania.
